summary: 327 commits on feature/phase1-equipment-cards (HEAD 04074ee, 2026-08-29); the phaser/ tree is 22,094 src TS/TSX lines in 258 files, of which 12,291 lines (56%) are React UI, with four monoliths over 600 lines (BoardScene.ts 1240, OverworldScene.tsx 970, combatReducer.ts 779, runStore.ts 684, App.tsx 627). Beta-0.1 (2026-07-06) shipped with 527 unit + 22 e2e tests green and was still unplayable: AP never reset (a58fe8d), the board went black from battle 2 (8b94151), and a 2026-08-28/29 full-run playtest found nine more P1s across combat, overworld, dungeon and persistence — the dominant failure class in this history is "designed, declared, never called" plumbing (eventBus had zero emitters for 3 months, captureTargets read by nothing, seedDungeonBattle dead code, InitiativeStrip specced but never built, save fields serialized but stripped on load) and "tests that cannot fail" (single-turn harnesses, visual snapshots masked to solid magenta, a full-hydration test that bypassed the real load path). Balance story 475 sat open two months on sim numbers (0% win / 90-100% stalemate) that were entirely engine bugs — corpse shadowing, melee AI stall, dungeon party never positioned — and once fixed the game wins 100% in 2-6 turns even gearless, so the standing direction is tune THREAT UP and treat any sim stalemate as an engine smoke alarm. The owner has settled, via the question picker, three forks that must not be re-litigated: ONE open-sheet 25-40 node 2-D map with hub towns (not three chained west-march strips), FIELD LEDGER UI (daylight linen page + saddle-leather field; candle-lit grimdark and Banner & Rope / Campaign Map rejected), and engine-gaps-first (done). Game-design decisions locked in docs/superpowers/specs/2026-03-29-ship-plan-design.md and memory design_decisions_core: deterministic card combat (capture is the sole RNG roll), gear-IS-the-deck via two hand slots, no morale, no auto-heals, weapon triangle / sharpness / quick slots / blacksmith cut, enemies use authored AI not cards, permadeath. Narrative truth is docs/worldbuilding/story-bible.md (M&B free mercenary company, dragon-egg spine, Corwin Vale / Mercer Kaine / Bagrat "Oak"), built turn-by-turn with the owner — generated creative docs were explicitly rejected. There is UNCOMMITTED work on disk dated 2026-09-04 (drawing-maps skill, autotile.ts, boardFloor.ts, map-tool.ts, bake-board-sprites.ts, board render fixes in 12 modified files) that a scorched-earth rebuild would lose. The rebuilder's real inheritance is the pure-systems layer, the content JSON, the Field Ledger tokens, the ComfyUI sprite pipeline, the headless CLI concept, and a short list of regression tests that encode every shipped bug.

requirements.text: Every turn/round loop must have ONE test that runs 3+ FULL cycles and asserts restoration invariants each cycle: AP back to AP_PER_TURN, hand refilled to HAND_SIZE, discard reshuffled into draw with zero card loss, statuses expire. Single-transition tests shipped a P0.
requirements.source: memory lesson_multiturn_blindspot.md; commit a58fe8d; phaser/tests/unit/systems/combatReducer.gear.test.ts:272 ('endTurn: turn-start restoration')

requirements.text: Before tuning any number against a sim, reproduce one battle by hand and confirm damage lands, enemies close, and both sides are on the board. A 100%-stalemate sim result is an engine bug until proven otherwise; the sim AI is a floor, validate against manual play.

Balance direction is UP on enemy threat (HP, pack size, burst), NOT up on party power. Post-fix baseline is 100% win in 2-6 turns everywhere including the boss, gearless. Targets: stub w/ starters 55-75% win, boss w/ epic+ 40-60%, 0% stalemates, 4-10 turns.
Target resolution must require a LIVING unit at the tile. A live enemy standing on a corpse was immune to every single-target card.

Melee AI approach must path around blockers (BFS distance field from destination), never axis-greedy stepToward. One party unit on the sole approach tile froze enemies into bare endTurns forever — the sim's dominant 'stalemate'.
Every battle seeder must place the party on the board. Run-store units carry position:null; seedDungeonBattle skipped placement so all dungeon rooms soft-locked at the turn cap.
A 1-turn self-buff (taunt/riposte/cover) played on the unit's own turn must survive the following enemy phase (ActiveStatus.fresh exemption). Otherwise every such card pays AP for nothing.

Team membership is an explicit Unit.team field with ONE helper (systems/team.ts). Never a classId/name substring heuristic and never duplicated per view — 5 of 9 enemy groups rendered as allies, capture was silently bandit-only, and the CLI renderer kept its own stale list.
Unit identity (sprites, portraits, capture, quest predicates) keys on unit id, never display name. Capture sets a flag, never mutates the name. Renames must be data-only.

The game canvas container must be permanently mounted and visibility-toggled, never conditionally rendered per view. Unmounting detached the Phaser canvas and every battle after the first drew into a void.

Hop/travel driver rules: roll an encounter at most ONCE per hop (a retried hop re-rolled the same event 34x); the resume effect must depend on EVERY modal that can pause it (check events, dialogue, quick menu); commitTravel must close any open quick menu; per-map UI state resets on mapId change.
Hop RNG must advance between crossings of the same road (edgeTraversals count in the rng label, bumped only when a hop LANDS, 3-day cooldown). Otherwise a road re-rolls the same encounter all run.

Save round-trip test must go through the REAL load path (serialize → buildSaveFile → saveToString → loadFromString). Zod strips undeclared keys, so any field serialized but missing from the load schema is silently dropped (daysElapsed, runStats, oneShotsFired were).

No 'declared, never called' plumbing. Any bus, listener table, or contract field must have a real emitter/reader in the same commit or must not exist. eventBus had ZERO emit call sites for ~3 months; captureTargets was in the domain type + Zod schema and read by nothing.

Every navigational affordance is a real pressable whose hit RECT covers its visual (react-aria cancels a press released outside the element rect). The region gateway was a plain div for months; an overhanging building sprite over a 48px dot was unclickable.
requirements.source: commit 04074ee; memory lesson_ui_input_layering.md 'React Aria press-rect gotcha'

requirements.text: Pan-vs-click gating must reset after the gesture's own click (macrotask), not only on the pan path, so a single drag cannot latch every later node click closed.
Victory inside a dungeon returns to the dungeon (boss room clears activeDungeon first); never eject to the world map mid-crawl.

Generated graphs must have unique node ids (dungeon boss room was built by the column scan AND pushed again). Quest display tables must fall back to the quest registry so a missing entry can never lose the quest's identity.
Combat must engage on turn 1: enemies spawn within one move+attack of the party (bandits at col 8-9 vs party col 0-2 on a 14-wide grid). An 11-tile gap read as 'combat is broken'.
Clicking the current node re-enters its scene (town/camp/dungeon) with no hop and no food cost. Drag threshold 8px, not 3px.

Overworld travel is click-to-go: one click on a node travels immediately, auto-pathing intermediate stops; hover shows hop/food cost. The plan-then-confirm itinerary bar was removed because it read as 'points aren't clickable'.

All randomness threads through an RNG parameter with hierarchical deriveRng(parent,label); Math.random lint-banned; replay from action log must be deterministic (ForecastPanel once used a hardcoded seed-0 stream and broke replay).

The pure reducer is the authority for legality (moveUnit validates bounds + occupancy); views never gate rules. Pure systems never mutate inputs; copy arrays at every boundary (.slice()/[...arr]) — the Godot deck evaporated through one shared hand array.

UI lives in DOM; the canvas renders board things only (tiles, units, in-world animations, spatial pickers). Adding a button/menu to canvas reopens the rex-ui-clone trap. HUD overlay is pointer-events-none with pointer-events-auto children.

Fixed 1280×720 authored stage, uniformly transform-scaled and letterboxed; all overlays/modals/tooltips portal INTO the stage (react-aria defaults to document.body and rendered unscaled); layout math uses STAGE_W/H not window.inner*.

requirements.text: Esc that cancels a selection must not also open the pause menu; battle end must retire the command chrome and NAME THE FALLEN (permadeath had zero acknowledgement).

Visual snapshot tests must be provably able to fail: no full-stage masks, tolerance 0.0005 (at 0.02 the suite could not see the accent colour change), and a deliberate token change must red the suite.

Dev server pinned to a non-default port with strictPort (5183; :5173 belongs to another app on this machine); Electron/desktop URL and docs must match; Playwright reuseExistingServer must never silently test a foreign app (PW_BASE_URL override).
Content validation (Zod over all content JSON) must actually run at boot, not only in tests. The old validateContent was called from tests only despite the invariant.

Combat is deterministic: no hit/miss/crit; card damage = card.damage + STR (or MAG) − floor(DEF/2) (or RES/2) − terrain, min 0. Capture is the SOLE RNG roll. Enemies use authored role AI (rusher/archer/healer/tank), not cards.

requirements.text: Gear IS the deck: deck = innate class cards (4-5) + left hand (3-4) + right hand (3-4); 2H weapon in left locks right; quivers modify bow cards and contribute none; no mid-combat swaps; cards carry a source tag.

Deck cycles Slay-the-Spire style: all cards start in draw, deal HAND_SIZE, ending unit discards whole hand, next draws to HAND_SIZE, reshuffle discard when dry. Pre-cycling every fight stalemated with empty hands.
Two-phase turn: one free move per unit per turn (no AP), then AP_PER_TURN of card plays; capture costs 2 AP.

CUT and do not reintroduce: morale, auto-heals, weapon triangle, weapon sharpness, quick slots, blacksmith, whetstone, camp sharpen, BATTLE/EVENT map node types. Healing is a player choice (Inn costs gold, camp/rest costs food).

Map model is ONE open sheet: a single contiguous 25-40 node 2-D world with hub towns, omnidirectional travel (M&B-style), replacing the three chained west-march region strips. Rejected alternatives: cheap backtracking, cycle-of-realms. Do not re-propose.

Before building the overworld, resolve the recorded tension: omnidirectional sandbox vs the node-map + food-per-hop economy that assumes directed travel. Keep the travel-risk model (more hops = more encounter rolls + more food) but not a one-way march; difficulty must not key on region tier → level band alone.

requirements.text: UI tone is FIELD LEDGER: quartermaster's ledger and camp table in daylight. PAGE (linen canvas, walnut ink, brass pins) for information screens; FIELD (saddle leather + brass over dark earth) for combat. Canvas = read, leather = act; one primary per view; nothing glows. Candle-lit / Forged & Lit look is rejected; the token SYSTEM survives.

No player-facing UI change is done until it has been screenshotted rendered and swept against the amateur-signals checklist (Iron Rule). The beta UI shipped 'artificial and amateurish' because no step looked at the screen.

Map work: the model emits a structured plan (ASCII route sketch), code does tiling/autotiling/lint, then render and look. Rules: critical path first, no one-tile passages, enemies 2-3× player units placed per 'where the player is on turn N'.

Character art comes from the local ComfyUI pipeline in the Fire-Emblem look (vibrant heroic anime-fantasy pixel sprites); the muted GoT restyle and the procedural pixel toolkit were rejected for characters. Board sprites are pre-baked ÷8 with LINEAR filtering (nearest-downscaling 1216px PNGs was the pixelated-characters bug).

Story pillars are locked and not up for re-pitching: grounded M&B mercenary company; dragons the one fantastical element, extinct ~300 years; player-named foundling MC; BG3-style companions recruited via quests (NOT tavern shop-row hires); Corwin Vale killed by Mercer Kaine over the dragon egg; Kaine is the final boss with a three-act escalation ladder; Bagrat 'Oak' is the first companion with Genatsvale (first blow aimed at an adjacent ally lands on him, per ally per turn).

Creative direction (story/world/characters/tone) is built turn-by-turn with the owner as sketches; never deliver a finished generated creative doc; the bible records only (locked) decisions. Choices go through the AskUserQuestion picker, never prose 'X or Y?'. Implementation is autonomous — stop only for a concrete artifact or a genuine fork.
FE6 placeholder names (Roy/Marcus/Lilina) and the title 'Embermarch' are provisional; the rename waits for the owner and must be a content edit.

Difficulty scales by map position, not party levels (party power = gear): enemy level band per tier, +2 HP/level, +1 str/def every 2 levels, +1 skl/spd/res every 3; loot rarity keys off the same level.

Save/load is atomic (parse → alias → Zod → swap stores in one batch); validation failure returns to title, never half-loaded. Pre-alpha policy: schema changes nuke saves with a loud warning; track saveVersion, no migration ladder yet.
Manual playtest of a FULL run (title → tutorial → map → dungeon → boss → win/lose) before any build is called a beta. Two rounds of 'all green' harnesses preceded unfinishable builds.
Kill background node/tsx process TREES on Windows (Get-CimInstance … Stop-Process), not just the wrapper; orphans contend for the GPU/ports.

risks: MULTI-TURN BLIND SPOT: 527 unit + 22 e2e green shipped a P0 (AP never reset → all cards dead by round 3) because every harness resolved battles in one turn. Any turn/round/cycle system needs a 3+-cycle restoration test before it is 'done' (a58fe8d, lesson_multiturn_blindspot.md).

SIM AS ORACLE: two months of 'balance' work chased 0%-win/100%-stalemate numbers that were three engine bugs (corpse shadowing, axis-greedy AI stall, party spawned off-board). A stalemate metric is an engine smoke alarm; probing AP/hand and clearing them stopped one layer too early — targeting, pathing and seeding also need a hand-played repro (lesson_balance_inverted.md).

DECLARED-NEVER-CALLED: eventBus.emit had zero call sites; captureTargets was schema'd and read by nothing; seedDungeonBattle was dead code (every dungeon fight was 3 stub bandits); InitiativeStrip was specced and never built; Zod stripped serialized fields on load. Require an emitter/reader/test in the same commit as every declaration (c1304c4, 976a4ea, d9cd7bd, f120373).

TESTS THAT CANNOT FAIL: visual snapshots were masked into byte-identical solid-magenta squares at 2% tolerance; the full-hydration test bypassed loadFromString. Prove every safety net can red before trusting it (7aaadf4, f120373).

SHARED ARRAY REFERENCES: Godot's card_hand_ui set _current_hand = dm.hand then .clear()'d it — cards evaporated every turn, hours lost. Copy at every boundary; pure systems never mutate inputs (lesson_shared_arrays.md).

INPUT LAYERING: invisible anchor containers ate clicks (Godot MOUSE_FILTER_STOP; React overlays without pointer-events-none); react-aria cancels presses released outside the element RECT so overhanging visuals are unclickable; Phaser canvas listens to MouseEvent not PointerEvent (Playwright trap); targeting mode transitions must explicitly re-enable input (lesson_ui_input_layering.md, 4435352, a522e43).

CANVAS LIFECYCLE: conditionally mounting the canvas container destroyed Phaser after battle 1; queueMicrotask ran before React 19 committed the container (rAF poll fix); BootScene delayedCall → scene.start silently died under StrictMode double-mount; renderUnits running synchronously on dispatch snapped units before the walk tween (8b94151, b576638, f4a5a54).

PORT COLLISION: another app owns :5173 and Playwright's reuseExistingServer silently ran visual tests against it (75-92% diffs, phantom failures); the Electron default then pointed at :5174 for two months. Pin a port with strictPort and derive every consumer from one config (lesson_port_5173_collision.md).

TASKSTOP ORPHANS: on Windows, stopping a background bash/npm kills only the wrapper; detached node/tsx children keep running (three ComfyUI batches raced on a 6 GB GPU). Kill the process tree by CommandLine match (lesson_taskstop_orphans.md).

NAME/SUBSTRING IDENTITY: team detection by 'bandit' substring made wolves/brigands allies and a non-bandit boss impossible; sprites keyed on name substrings in three duplicated maps; capture mutated the display name. Key everything on ids and one helper (976a4ea, e157814).

HOP DRIVER AS useEffects: three separate soft-locks (quick menu open on commitTravel, check-event resume deps, retried hop re-rolling 34x) plus a pan latch and decorative gateways all came from effect-driven travel logic in a 970-line component. Model travel as explicit store state with a single pump (8b94151, 04074ee, project_overworld_grounding.md).
EMPTY FIRST TURNS: an 11-tile spawn gap on a 14-wide grid made working combat read as 'broken' (94bb909). Spawn distance is a feel requirement, not a tuning afterthought.

UI WITHOUT LOOKING: the beta UI shipped 'artificial and amateurish' because feature work never included a rendered-screenshot step; agents critique well when pointed at a screenshot but never do it unprompted (project_game_ui_skill.md). The overworld's first grounding attempt was rated 2/10 by the owner.

RE-CANDLING: three repo docs still partially teach the rejected candle-lit look and the memory explicitly predicts a future agent will re-candle the UI from them; read the 2026-08-28 spec first, not the older briefs (feedback_ui_direction_candlelit_out.md).
